events.description: Pop-Up: Our Periods, Ourselves: An Empowered Teen's Guide November 13, 2026 12:30 pm - 1:30 pm Denver Public Library: Blair-Caldwell African American Research Library, 2401 Welton St, Denver, CO 80205, USA Join Daring Girls for a conversation with Denver-based Dr. Mathangi Subramanian, an award winning author releasing her new book, Our Periods, Ourselves: An Empowered Teen’s Guide. events.title: Silent Book Club at MATTER November 14, 2026 1:00 pm - 3:00 pm The Shop at MATTER, 2114 Ma…
events.description: Silent Book Club at MATTER November 14, 2026 1:00 pm - 3:00 pm The Shop at MATTER, 2114 Market St, Denver, CO 80205, USA EVENT TYPE: BOOK CLUB Silent Book Club is a global community of readers and introverts, with more than 500 chapters in 50 countries around the world led by local volunteers. SBC members gather in public at bars, cafes, bookstores, libraries, and online to read together in quiet camaraderie. The Denver branch is gathering at The Shop at MATTER on the second Saturday of the month, 1:00-3:00pm. So grab your book and get ready to cozy up and read in beautiful silence with other members. Bring your own book, e-book, comic, audiobook, zine, textbook, or shop beforehand in our bookstore.

events.title: A Spiritual and Mystical Poetry Reading w/ Ghassen Ghediri November 20, 2026 2:00 pm - 4:0…
events.description: A Spiritual and Mystical Poetry Reading w/ Ghassen Ghediri November 20, 2026 2:00 pm - 4:00 pm The Shop at MATTER, 2114 Market St, Denver, CO 80205, USA An interactive and intimate gathering with Ghassen Ghediri, a Tunisian immigrant poet who blends philosophical reflection with transcendental poetry. Ghediri often weaves Arabic, French, and Latin into his work to explore themes of Divine Love, social justice, and spiritual liberation. He aspires to deconstruct frames and doctrines, and to speak to seekers across backgrounds and paths. Ghediri's writings reflect on inner struggles and challenge the status quo, touching on all forms of discrimination and injustice. This is an invitation to connect deeper with the treasure within all of us. If you're seeking inspiration, philosophical conversations or simply beautiful words that touch the Soul, this is for You. Beverages & delicious Tunisian dates will also be served to guests free of charge!

events.title: Gift Economy In Action!
events.description: November 29, 2026 11:00 am - 1:00 pm The Shop at MATTER, 2114 Market St, Denver, CO 80205, USA It's like a birthday. For everyone. All the time. Hosted by MATTER's Debra, Vania, and Laia on the last Sunday of most months Bring up to 10 (TEN!) things you'd like to gift to someone else. Once treasured but no longer wanted or needed. Art, jewelry, clothes, appliances, gerbils, albums, ... We'll most likely have conversations about value, economics, kindness, and maybe donuts Rules: - No US or foreign currency can be exchanged. - Must be present to gift. - Donuts will be gifted from MATTER. - What comes in, must go out. A direct action inspired by The Serviceberry , by Robin Wall Kimmerer No
